result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but there are a few minor visual issues: a truncated restaurant name, a partially cut-off card, and a promotional code that may be hard to notice.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated with no ellipsis, suggesting text is cut off mid-word
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol...') or use text-overflow handling so truncation is clearly indicated

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only the image with the -20% badge but no restaurant name, rating, or delivery info
issues.suggestion: Ensure enough of the card content is visible or add a scroll affordance so users know more content is below

issues.description: The promo code 'TALLINN3' in the green banner is plain text and easy to miss; users may not realize it needs to be entered manually
issues.suggestion: Make the promo code a tappable element with a 'Copy code' action to improve usability
